cards.card_text: Then God lists what they can bring: gold, silver and bronze, colored yarn, fine linen, goat hair, leather, acacia wood, olive oil, spices and gemstones.
cards.verse_text: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze; blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair; ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood; olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense; and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
cards.snippet: …fine linen and goat hair; ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood; olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and…

cards.card_text: First up: an ark of acacia wood, overlaid with pure gold inside and out, with a gold molding around it.
cards.verse_text: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
cards.snippet: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half…

cards.card_text: Then God moves on to a table of acacia wood, covered in pure gold, with a rim, a gold molding and four gold rings at its legs.
cards.verse_text: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
cards.snippet: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a…

cards.card_text: Then come the walls: acacia frames, twenty on each long side and eight at the back, every one standing on silver bases, braced with crossbars and overlaid with gold.
cards.verse_text: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
cards.snippet: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

cards.card_text: Next God lays out an altar of acacia wood, square, five cubits on each side and three cubits high.
cards.verse_text: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood.
cards.snippet: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood.

cards.card_text: Then acacia poles overlaid with bronze slide into the rings, one on each of two sides.
cards.verse_text: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
cards.snippet: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.

cards.card_text: Now He adds one more altar, made of acacia wood.
cards.verse_text: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
cards.snippet: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.

cards.card_text: This acacia wood altar gets one special job.
cards.verse_text: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
cards.snippet: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.

cards.card_text: Whoever has silver, bronze or acacia wood brings that too.
cards.verse_text: Also, everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the service brought it.
cards.snippet: Also, everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the service brought it.

cards.card_text: Then come the walls: upright frames of acacia wood, twenty on the south side, twenty on the north and more across the back, each one standing on two silver bases.
cards.verse_text: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
cards.snippet: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

cards.card_text: The veil hangs on four acacia posts overlaid with gold, with gold hooks.
cards.verse_text: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts.
cards.snippet: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks;…

cards.card_text: Now Bezalel, the lead craftsman, builds the ark out of acacia wood.
cards.verse_text: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
cards.snippet: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half…

cards.card_text: Next he makes a table of acacia wood, overlaid with pure gold, with gold rings and gold-covered poles for carrying it.
cards.verse_text: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
cards.snippet: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a…

cards.card_text: Next comes a small square altar of acacia wood, a cubit long and a cubit wide.
cards.verse_text: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood.
cards.snippet: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood.

cards.card_text: After the lampstand, Bezalel makes a small square altar of acacia wood overlaid with pure gold.
cards.verse_text: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood.
cards.snippet: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood.

cards.card_text: Bezalel builds the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood, square, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high.
cards.verse_text: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood.
cards.snippet: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood.

cards.card_text: So Moses makes an ark of acacia wood, chisels out two tablets like the originals and heads up the mountain with them in his hands.
cards.verse_text: So I made an ark of acacia wood, chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.
cards.snippet: So I made an ark of acacia wood, chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals, and went up…

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says He will plant cedars, acacias, myrtles and olive trees in the wilderness, and set cypresses, elms and boxwood together in the desert.
cards.verse_text: I will plant cedars in the wilderness, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees.
cards.snippet: I will plant cedars in the wilderness, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees.

cards.card_text: All the streams of Judah run with water, and a spring flows out to water the Valley of Acacias.
cards.verse_text: All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.
cards.snippet: …flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.
